description: This Java class defines an Android activity named LauncherSettingsActivity that acts as a forwarder to launch either the main settings or setup wizard based on whether the keyboard is enabled. It manages activity state to prevent re-creation and controls navigation flow within the app.

classes.name: LauncherSettingsActivity
classes.description: An Android activity that redirects to either the main settings or setup wizard depending on the keyboard's enabled state, with state management to avoid re-creation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and restores the 'launched' state if available.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Checks if the activity has already been launched; if not, it starts the appropriate settings activity based on whether the keyboard is enabled.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Saves the 'launched' state to handle configuration changes.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Restores the 'launched' state after a configuration change.
